entries.zh: 记账；把收支数目记入备忘簿
entries.en: to record the accounts; to enter receipts and expenses in a memorandum book

entries.zh: 记入账簿；在收支簿上登记
entries.en: to write in the book of expenses and receipts; to keep the account ledger

entries.zh: 记账；开列、分派账目入簿（「派數」）
entries.en: to enter accounts in a ledger; to set out or apportion the accounts
entries.notes: H 栏首字[疑:派/汖]，M/R 均作 pây/pāy，支持「派數」；L 栏仅作 en libro de quentas，义赖汉栏补足。

entries.zh: 在板、牌上书写
entries.en: to write on a tablet or board
entries.notes: H 栏下字[疑:水/土]，M 欄 sûy 与 R 欄 tv 不一致；释义据 L「escriuir en tabla」定。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏「TABLEO…mahycaptigalle」严重残损不可解，H/M 仅存「起去」(khì-khù)，无法与西语词头对应。

entries.zh: 代笔；替他人书写
entries.en: to write in another's place; to write on someone's behalf, to ghost-write

entries.zh: 代书；替人代写文书
entries.en: to write for another; to act as a scribe on someone's behalf
entries.notes: L 栏带墨框，为重复/补录词头标记，与第 6 条同义异文。

entries.zh: 题诗；书写诗句
entries.en: to write verses; to inscribe a poem
entries.notes: L 栏末段「lengua span ges」残损，疑为「lengua española」；H/M/R 三栏一致作「題詩」。

entries.zh: 题写标签、题签（寺院募捐题名）
entries.en: to write a label or notice-slip; to inscribe a subscription label (at the temple, asking alms)
entries.notes: L 栏「llave del templo」疑为「tabla」之误，H/M/R 三栏均指「題標籤」之题签。

entries.zh: 题写柱联；于长条纸上题对联
entries.en: to write couplets on long strips of paper; to inscribe pillar couplets
entries.notes: H 栏中字[疑:柱/桂]，取「柱聯」；R 欄 chy lien 支持末字「聯」，L 栏 papeles largos 亦合长条联纸。

entries.zh: 简写；以缩写形式书写
entries.en: to write in abbreviated form; to abbreviate in writing
entries.notes: H 栏中字[疑:省/首]，R 欄 feng 与 M 欄 sē 不相对应，唯 L 栏 en abreviatura 义明。

entries.zh: 誊写到簿册上；把账目、文稿过录进簿中
entries.en: to copy or transcribe into the book (or into the chapter)
entries.notes: R 栏空白，依 L「en el libro, o el Capitulo」与 H/M「謄上簿」定。

entries.zh: 誊写票照；把标识、特征写进许可证
entries.en: to copy out a permit; to write the identifying marks on a licence
entries.notes: L 栏「taligencia」疑为「la licencia」；R 栏污损（T99），据 H/M「謄票」定。

entries.zh: 写大字；以大字、大本的格式书写
entries.en: to write in large characters, in large format
entries.notes: L 栏「Bouerra」难解（疑为「en borra」草稿），以 H/M「大本寫」(tūa-pún-siá) 为准。

entries.zh: 书籍；簿册
entries.en: books; registers or written records
entries.notes: R 栏污损、L 栏「el nombre Sierra」与汉栏不合，仅据 M 欄 cū chep（書籍）定，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 书写时把事由（正文）置于下方
entries.en: to write with the matter placed below; to set the subject-matter underneath
entries.notes: H 栏下字[疑:書/昷]、R 栏空白，M 欄 sūy cūn 与 H 不对应，仅 L 栏「poniendo la materia de bajo」可据。

entries.zh: 训字；解释字义，以训诂方式书写
entries.en: to gloss characters; to write out the explanation of characters
entries.notes: H 栏次字[疑:順]，M 欄 cūn xy（kùn-jī）支持「訓字」；L 栏「en forma a la materia」文义难解。

entries.zh: 开榜；张榜公布考选通过的官员名单
entries.en: to post the roll of approved mandarins; to publish the list of successful candidates
entries.notes: R 栏记录异常（作「字」且 T99）；L/H/M 三栏一致作「開榜」(khui-pńg)。

entries.zh: 简写；扼要、截短地书写
entries.en: to write succinctly; to write in a cut-short, concise form
entries.notes: L 栏「su cinta mente」为「sucintamente」之误分写；H/M 作「可截寫」(ká-tshiat-siá)。

entries.zh: 灵旌；为亡者题写姓名于旌旗以表哀荣（即铭旌）
entries.en: to inscribe the dead person's name on a funeral banner for honour; the name-banner (mingjing) of the deceased
entries.notes: H 栏首字[疑:靈/銘]，M 欄 lēng 支持「靈旌」；R 栏空白，L 栏名、亡者、旌表三事与汉栏互证。
